issues.display_title: Issue #50: feat: public Street View thumbnail for google-type photographer portfolio
issues.main_description_html:
Problem

Adding a photographer portfolio item of type google stores the thumbnail from the page's og:image, which for 360 photospheres is a session-signed lh3.googleusercontent.com/gpms-cs-s/... URL. The token expires, so stored thumbnails start returning 403.

Solution

New helper helpers.GetGoogleStreetViewThumbnail(value):

  1. Resolves maps.app.goo.gl short links (extracted ResolveGoogleMapsShortLink, reused by GenerateGoogleMapsEmbedUrl).
  2. Extracts the panorama id from the !1s<panoid>!2e<type> segment.
  3. User photospheres (!2e10): mints a fresh public gpms-cs-s URL via the photometa/v1 endpoint (no auth, no API key), returned as =w900-h600-k-no.
  4. Official Street View (!2e0): stable streetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com/v1/thumbnail URL.

Wired into resolveThumbnailForType (PortfolioTypeGoogle) — used by both create and update portfolio; falls back to the old og:image path for non–street-view links.

Files

  • src/helpers/googleMapsEmbed.go — helper + short-link resolver
  • src/action/v1/portfolio/portfolioHelper.go — wiring
  • src/helpers/googleMapsEmbed_test.go — live test

Testing

go test -run TestGetGoogleStreetViewThumbnail_Live ./src/helpers/ — 5 real short links must resolve and serve 200 image/* publicly (no cookies): 5/5 pass.

Known limitation

Minted gpms-cs-s URLs still expire eventually (marked with ponytail: comment). If stored thumbnails 403 again: re-mint on read, or cache image bytes to our own storage at create time.
